column3: MT 12:5. The Hebrew is difficult (“money passing along, each the money of persons of his valuation”); NASB renders “in current money, both the money of each man’s assessment.”
MT 12:11. “Tied up” is rendered “tied it in bags.”
MT 12:16. “Settled accounts” is rendered “require an accounting.”
MT 12:19. “Went up from on Jerusalem” is rendered “went away from Jerusalem.”
MT 12:21. “Beth-millo which goes down to Silla” is rendered “at the house of Millo as he was going down to Silla”; the meaning is uncertain.
MT 12:22. The Hebrew reads “Jozabad”; NASB has “Jozacar,” following many manuscripts.
